447312.findings: Oil still life of wattle and gum leaves in a brass pot, in gilt frame with linen slip. Signed lower left; enlarged crop reads 'H. Targett', consistent with the title. Decorative amateur or regional work, no known market for this name.

448165.findings: Two Jon Kudelka cartoon prints, each captioned under the image: 'The Australian 19.2.11 "Bowls and Sex" Kudelka.' and 'The Australian 13.8.11 "Not With A Bang" Kudelka.' Kudelka is a well known Hobart-based cartoonist who sells his own prints; the lettering looks like his hand but may be part of the print. No edition number seen.
448165.condition: Cream frames with minor marks; images look clean.
448165.reason: Pair of Jon Kudelka cartoon prints, collectable Tasmanian cartoonist with local following.
448165.marks_read: Kudelka; The Australian 19.2.11 Bowls and Sex; The Australian 13.8.11 Not With A Bang
